name: Pinfall
description: Shoulders held to the mat for a three count.

name: Submission
description: The opponent gives up to a hold.

name: Knockout
description: The opponent cannot answer the referee's count.

name: Referee Stoppage
description: The referee ends the match because one side cannot go on safely.

name: Count-Out
description: One side stays outside the ring past the referee's count.

name: Disqualification
description: One side breaks the rules badly enough that the referee awards the match to the other.
